    अभ्यास

    Welcome to Abhyāsa!

    Learn the Sanskrit of scripture — enough to read a verse and see for yourself what it says, to follow the words of a rite while you perform it, and to carry them into your own practice.

    The course runs in five tracks, from your first words to composition, poetry, Vedic recitation and Avadhāna. Each one teaches one new thing at a time, then gives you a few ways to make it yours — some cards ask you to recall a word, some to choose between forms, some to put a line back in order.

    Anything you get right comes back later on, so what you learn early stays with you while you move on. Beside every track there is extra vocabulary, open from the start and never required.

    Sanskrit is written in the Devanāgarī script. If you cannot read it yet, open Devanāgarī at the top of the menu first — it teaches the shapes and nothing else, and it takes an evening or two. If you can, skip it; it is not part of any track.
